I opened the report as a versioned, sandboxed artifact beside this chat and wrote it section by section. It can be exported to Word, Excel, PowerPoint or PDF, and it has a share link whenever you want to send it on.

Run the tests in a terminal
Thinking
Open the terminal dock with the Mod+J shortcut.
Start a real shell in the project folder.
Propose the command on an approval card first.

The command waited behind an approval card, then ran in the dock's real terminal. Claude shows each command it runs and each file it changes, so nothing happens out of sight. Open the dock again any time with Mod+J.

Serve FormAT as an MCP server while it runs.
While FormAT runs it is an MCP server at 127.0.0.1:8490/mcp, and every engine command is a tool for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor. Pair your phone with a QR code to carry on a chat there, live.
